purpose: sha256 fingerprints of banned private identifiers
note: Cleartext values live only in the private repository and in the owner's own request that generated this file — they are never written here or anywhere else in this tree. Each entry is sha256(hex) of one banned identifier plus a generic type label (never anything that identifies which specific value it is). scripts/publication-gate-core.mjs hashes candidate tokens extracted from tracked file content and fails the gate on any match, reporting only the first 8 hex characters of the matched hash.
